entries.question: Q1

reported.abstract_and_3_7: final practical choice is Canny + post-processing due annotation cost/interpretability

entries.audit: Not necessarily a contradiction if accuracy and deployment utility are different objectives, but the paper does not quantify either tradeoff. Registry must distinguish predictive winner from recommended practical route.

entries.question: Q2
entries.audit: Means are broadly consistent after rounding, but the table contains nine rows rather than seven and no significance test/effect-size uncertainty is reported.

entries.question: Q2
entries.audit: Visible fixed 3-component GMM call cannot generate the 5/1/3 reported instance counts without a different hidden execution path.

entries.question: Q2
entries.audit: Treat P as a known physical constant when diameter is fixed, or provide evidence it was estimated. Do not describe a fixed value as learned/fitted.

entries.question: Q3
entries.audit: Multiple JRC mappings coexist without a canonical source/calibration/evaluation contract. Cross-paper comparison must freeze one official/canonical formula before judging values.

entries.question: Q3
entries.source: section 5.5 summary vs displayed improved formula

reported.claim: introduces curvature Z3 and area correction factor
reported.displayed_formula: contains Z3 and alpha/beta/gamma only, no area A

entries.audit: Area analysis is descriptive; the displayed improved estimator does not contain an area term, so an area-correction claim is not formula-supported.

entries.question: Q4

reported.body: six simulated boreholes; mouth/depth/fracture parameters set with engineering common sense

entries.audit: Q4 tables/figures are scenario-model outputs unless an attachment-derived mapping is separately demonstrated; they cannot be registered as direct attachment-4 results.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: Without labeled connectivity outcomes or a calibrated generative model this is a monotone compatibility score, not verified probability.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: For a binary event Shannon entropy also includes -(1-p)log2(1-p). The printed quantity is an additive hotspot score, not standard Bernoulli entropy.

entries.question: Q4

reported.goal: maximum information gain / maximum global uncertainty reduction

entries.audit: Current prior entropy does not equal expected information gain; true IG requires expected posterior entropy after possible observations.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: The third reported recommendation violates the stated 500 mm hard constraint and the code threshold itself drifts to 300 mm. Feasibility must be enforced before ranking.

entries.question: Q4
entries.audit: The visible fixed-data loader cannot support the deep body intervals; result provenance is unresolved.

entries.question: Q4

reported.identify_high_uncertainty: uses self.uncertainty_data after no visible assignment

entries.audit: Printed code cannot reproduce the uncertainty table and drilling recommendation as a self-contained chain.

entries.question: Q3/Q4
entries.source: Q3 JRC definition/results + Q4 section 6.3.3 + Appendix D
entries.audit: The paper declares the conventional JRC range 0-20 but reports Q3 values above 20 and then uses 20 as the Q4 similarity normalization denominator. Without clipping/calibration or an explicit extended scale, the similarity contract can become negative and is not range-safe.

global_gates: model recommendation must separate predictive evidence from deployment cost
same-instance curve fitting is not cross-instance generalization
reported instance count must be compatible with clustering configuration
roughness derivative estimator requires an ordered profile contract
binary entropy requires complement probability or a normalized categorical distribution
information gain requires a posterior-update expectation
simulated/assumed inputs must be labeled scenario evidence
hard constraints must be replayed against every final recommendation
